Cq.bar_b_note: B's mottled black-gold scales reach the naturalistic bar, but A's glossy cartoon banding and serpent hovering metres in the air during the faint sink the set as a whole.

Eu.bar_b_note: Standing Tanglevolt matches the owner style bar in fur and silhouette and B's crisp white-violet arcs carry it, though the hovering, belly-white faint poses hold it back.

Fl.bar_b_note: A's dense fleece and heavy curled horns sit at the owner bar with a grounded faint, while B's inverted, patchy, floating faint frames would not pass.

Rt.bar_b_note: A clean, appealing elder villager with readable eyes and an earthy green-brown palette that fits the key art's world, held back only by flat neutral-stage lighting.

Nd.bar_b_note: Dark muddy brown floor with no purple storm sky or blue-green moss, flat magenta ring telegraphs, an unreadable player creature and a HUD covering a third of the frame sink it, with B also putting the camera inside foliage in i11-i15.

top_changes.change: Stormwood fight: replace flat magenta ring/outline telegraphs with lit lightning/ground-crack effects and impact flashes, add camera collision so it never sits inside canopy or trunks, grade the arena to the board's purple storm sky with blue-green moss and rim light on both fighters, and shrink/compact the HUD panels

Ground every faint pose: snap the fainted body to the stage so it meets its shadow (Cq A serpent airborne, Eu both sides, Fl B inverted floating ram) and keep faint poses upright-readable rather than flipped belly-up
Fulgocobra material: keep B's naturalistic scale texture but lift values and sharpen the gold scale lines toward the Stormwood board so the coil reads at small size instead of as a dark tangle
